verdict.rationale: Make's help docs have a dedicated error-handling page covering error handlers and how to use them, which supports defining error-handling paths in scenarios. The pack has no evidence that Make notifies users when a scenario run fails. Missing for 10: documented failure notifications (email or alerts on failed runs), detail on the error handler types and how error routes work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails

citations.quote: detailed information on common errors and warnings, error handlers, and how to use them
